title: 新唐書 卷二二〇 東夷 日本
edition: Wikisource digital transcription (unproofread); locators re-checked against it on 2026-09-24
author: 歐陽修, 宋祁

license.notes: Text public domain. Used only for the 天寶十二載 notice of 朝衡's return to the Tang court and the outline of his career.

notes: Song-era history compiled in 1060, later than the events it reports. It reports 朝衡 (阿倍仲麻呂) returning to the Tang court in 天寶十二載 and later holding office; it does not give a death year in the passage checked.
